problem: An external project worker must create one scoped working note with attributable provenance, retrieve its stable ID, search it, stop/restart the provider, then retrieve it again without direct HTTP/database/framework coupling.
existingInsufficient: Frozen echo is side-effect-free; example.records is opaque replaceable key/value without governed scope/provenance/candidate semantics or search. Agent-execution and decision-evaluate do not provide durable governed memory. Changing their semantics is prohibited.
abstraction: One generic working-candidate capability create/get/search. Breaking v2 adds mandatory requestKey to create payload and disables Host-level idempotency; persistence is an explicit normative shared-domain guarantee, not an instance cache claim. No new public binding/platform or domain promotion/import authority.
providers: Governed MemoryV4 shared-domain SQLite adapter (authorized planned implementation, not yet built)
Any independent governed candidate provider satisfying these public semantics; no requirement to implement one speculatively
consumers: External public-SDK project working-note consumer; create/get/search/restart/get with no MemoryV4, FastAPI or SQLite imports
alternatives: Original durable Host policy is rejected by frozen public Host and ContractProvider. Merely instance relabeling rejected: Host caches success/errors and can bypass current domain reauthorization. Revised v2 uses domain requestKey and transport idempotency none so every call reaches current authority checks. No Kernel/ACAP/Foundation edits.
security: Trusted Host caller mapped by operator to actor/data-root/permitted domain operations on EVERY attempt; requestKey is non-authoritative request data. No caller identity/grants in payload. Current domain create authorization precedes durable replay. Same-actor key conflicts on changed scope/content; distinct actor namespace cannot replay another actor result. Retry is explicit after ambiguity; committed mutation and ledger are atomic; no automatic retries or rollback promises.
scopes: Existing application/session Catalog labels and Host scope/grants unchanged. Requested memory scope must equal/descend separately mapped data-root; visible ancestor candidates only; no public opt-in or sibling leakage. Catalog permission metadata grants nothing.
compatibility: Breaking additive v2 draft, different major and digest. Original reviewed v1 files/receipt remain unchanged; their review/admission does not transfer. Consumer moves from CallOptions.idempotencyKey to payload.requestKey; v1 and v2 never silently resolve as compatible. Existing HTTP API unchanged. Minimum durability remains24h and restart-stable replay; Host generic replay guarantee is explicitly not offered.
genericRationale: Scoped attributable working text candidates and lexical retrieval are reusable across project workers/providers; no tenant names, MemoryV4 endpoints or SQLite representation in the contract.
